definitions.gloss: prime of life; vigorous middle age
definitions.explanation: The period of life when a person is at peak physical and mental vigor, roughly corresponding to the 30s through 50s. Carries a positive connotation of strength and maturity.

examples.japanese: {壮年|そうねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧。

⟦{壮年期|そうねんき}→壮年期：26410_sounenki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: After entering middle age, you come to appreciate the importance of physical fitness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{壮年|そうねん}にして⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大企業|だいきぎょう}→大企業：12277_daikigyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{育|そだ}て{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: In the prime of his life, he built the company into a large corporation.

notes:
Compound of {壮|そう} (vigorous, robust) and ⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ (year, age). Unlike ⟦{中年|ちゅうねん}→中年：11307_chuunen⟧ (middle age), which can carry a neutral or slightly negative connotation, {壮年|そうねん} emphasizes vigor and capability.

AGE STAGES IN JAPANESE:
- ⟦{青年|せいねん}→青年：03292_seinen⟧ — youth; young adult (roughly teens to 20s)
- {壮年|そうねん} — prime of life (roughly 30s to 50s)
- ⟦{中年|ちゅうねん}→中年：11307_chuunen⟧ — middle age (roughly 40s to 50s; overlaps with {壮年|そうねん} but less positive)
- ⟦{老年|ろうねん}→老年：14072_rounen⟧ — old age (roughly 60s and beyond)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{壮年期|そうねんき}→壮年期：26410_sounenki⟧ — the prime of life (as a life stage)
- {壮年|そうねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧ — a man in his prime
- {壮年|そうねん}にして — in one's prime

REGISTER:
Somewhat formal and literary. In everyday speech, ⟦{中年|ちゅうねん}→中年：11307_chuunen⟧ or specific age references are more common.
